input.name: selectors-before-start
input.covers: The capability exists from createKernel(); with no panes the selectors are empty, get() and documentView() are null.

input.name: first-open-makes-a-pane
input.covers: The effect reconciles whenever the open order changes: the first open (while still loading) creates view-1 and assigns the document to it; later opens land in the focused pane; get/documentView/list read it back as copies.

input.name: closing-prunes
input.covers: Closing a document drops it from its pane and picks a neighbour as active; closing every document leaves the empty pane.

input.name: panes
input.covers: createView focuses the new pane and later opens land there; removeView refocuses; moveView reorders with clamping and ignores unknown ids; setFocused takes any id.

input.name: tabs
input.covers: addDocument/removeDocument/setActiveDocument/moveDocumentWithin/moveDocumentBetween dispatch their actions; the reducer ignores the invalid ones.

input.name: reordering-tabs-reconciles
input.covers: documents.move changes the open order, so the effect reconciles (a no-op for pane contents); setActive alone does not.

input.name: a-failed-open
input.covers: A document whose open fails keeps its tab in the order (status error), so it stays assigned until it is closed.

input.name: create-populated-and-split
input.covers: createPane with documentIds creates the pane, then moves each document into it (out of the pane that held it); splitPane(documentId) is createPane with that one document, and ignores its from option.

input.name: remove-pane-targets
input.covers: removePane moves its documents to moveDocumentsTo when given, else to the focused pane when that is another one, else to the last remaining pane; a target that is the pane itself or unknown moves nothing, and removing the only pane drops its documents with it.

input.name: events
input.covers: Every write is diffed: onPaneCreated for each new pane in order, onPaneRemoved for each removed one, onFocusChanged when the focus changes, and onDocumentMoved for each document whose pane changed (a document opening moves from null, one closing to null). A throwing listener is reported and its siblings still fire; after unsubscribing nothing fires.
input.reason: Pins the pane events each write fires, which the event callbacks record. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

input.name: a-kernel-refuses-the-shipping-plugin
input.covers: The shipping viewManagerPlugin() cannot be installed: its controller spreads its context, which reads the workspace doc getter, which throws, so createKernel throws. Every other case installs it through a factory that hides doc.

input.name: destroy
input.covers: After destroy the effect is gone and the capability no longer resolves.
